// Classifier fixture, node:test: CONDITIONAL-ONLY, the CONDITIONAL and GUARDED-RETURN flags, and
// their negative. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

test("parses the year", () => {
  const result = parse("2024");
  result.ok && assert.equal(result.value.year, 2024);
});

test("creates the asset", (t) => {
  const result = MediaAsset.create(input);
  if (!result.ok) {
    return;
  }
  t.assert.equal(result.value.kind, "image");
});

test("creates the asset after asserting success", () => {
  const result = MediaAsset.create(input);
  assert.ok(result.ok);
  if (!result.ok) return;
  assert.equal(result.value.kind, "image");
});

test("reads the profile after asserting it is present", () => {
  const profile = load();
  assert.notEqual(profile, null);
  if (profile == null) return;
  assert.equal(profile.name, "Ada");
});

test("reads the name after asserting its type", () => {
  const name = read();
  assert.equal(typeof name, "string");
  if (typeof name === "string") {
    assert.equal(name.trim(), "Ada");
  }
});

test("reads the first result, the only one asserted", () => {
  const first = parse("1");
  const second = parse("2");
  assert.ok(first.ok);
  if (!first.ok || !second.ok) return;
  assert.equal(first.value, 1);
});

test("reports the load error through catch", async () => {
  await load().catch((error) => {
    assert.equal(error.code, "LOAD_FAILED");
  });
});
